title: Attention gate w_g never initialized — uses uninitialized memory
trigger_conditions: Attention with attention gating (w_g not None)
root_cause: init_attention initialized w_q/w_k/w_v (and w_qkv for FusedAttention) but never touched the optional gate projection w_g. When constructed via nn.Linear with init_device='meta'/'cpu', w_g.weight held whatever values reset_parameters or torch.empty produced rather than the intended trunc-normal distribution.
invariant: Every learnable Linear weight in attention (including the optional gate projection) must be initialized exactly once via _init_linear before training starts.
diff_summary: Add `if m.w_g is not None: self._init_linear(m.w_g, std=g_std, generator=generator)` after the q/k/v block.
silent_check: Initialization completes without exception — w_g.weight is a finite tensor (whatever empty/reset_parameters left it as); the model trains, just from an unintended starting distribution for the gate.
